description: Ranks AP exams for one year by pass rate (share scoring 3 or higher), share of 5s, mean score or number of test takers (mean and test takers for 2024 and 2025 only), using the official College Board distributions. Give a list of exams to compare a few, or leave it empty to rank all of them.

exams.description: Exams to compare, e.g. ["Calc AB", "Calc BC", "Statistics"]. Empty means all exams.

order.description: desc = highest first (default), asc = lowest first.

sort_by.description: Ranking key. Default pass_rate (3 or higher).

year.description: Exam year (May administration). Available: 2024, 2025, 2026. Default 2026, the latest College Board release.

name: compare_ap_exams
title: Compare AP exams by pass rate or share of 5s
